title: Explicit Vulkan selection is blocked by an inactive DX12 compiler override
summary: WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan plus inherited WGPU_DX12_COMPILER=staticdxc fails before instance creation. Reproduced independently before PR721 and at its exact current head. Removing only the compiler override permits Vulkan execution.
call_order_proof: The platform mask is narrowed by WGPU_BACKEND to Vulkan; adapter() calls enumerate(), then instance(). instance() parses all BackendOptions and calls backend_options() before cache lookup or wgpu::Instance::new(). backend_options() rejects StaticDxc without inspecting the attempted mask. wgpu-types30.0.1 src/backend.rs824-852 parses the environment override as StaticDxc.

minimal_reproduction.nature: Original reproduction data for an authorized tester; receiving this report does not authorize execution.
minimal_reproduction.expected: Nonzero CLI run exit with staticdxc refusal before Instance::new; exact baseline observation below. PR721 additionally writes a bounded solver_error record if the report directory is allowed and writable.
